issues.title: Add --version flag to factory.js
issues.prompt: In factory/factory.js, add support for a --version command line flag. When the script is run with --version, it should print the version string (read it from package.json version field, or hardcode '0.1.0') and exit immediately without doing anything else. Keep the change small and self-contained.
issues.reviewer_notes: Verify the flag short-circuits before any deploy happens.
